name: GD Forge
description: Lets an AI assistant build in the level editor through MCP

enabled.name: Enable bridge
enabled.description: Listen on localhost so the GD Forge MCP server can drive the editor. Takes effect after restarting the game.

port.name: Port
port.description: Local port the bridge listens on. Must match the <cy>GDFORGE_PORT</c> of the MCP server. Takes effect after restarting the game.
